comment: Shared truth for the two splitXThread implementations (js/x-thread.js and supabase/functions/_shared/platforms.ts). Both test suites assert every case; a semantic change to either splitter must update this file, which forces the other side's suite to notice. Exactly the mechanism test/fixtures/effective-text-cases.json uses for effectiveText. A case carries either `tweets` (the exact chain, suffixes included) or `error` (the one refusal that survives threading). ADR 0005 publishing depth, X threads amendment.

cases.text: Ship day. The planner now speaks X.
tweets: Ship day. The planner now speaks X.
